This pull request is being closed because it only changes existing admin translation files under `packages/admin/dashboard/src/i18n/translations/`.

Existing translation files are kept in sync with `en.json` automatically by the `admin-i18n-sync.yml` workflow, so manual edits to them aren't accepted. If you spotted a wrong translation, please open an issue describing it instead.

To add a new language, open an issue first, get assigned to it, and open a pull request that only adds the new locale file and links that issue.
